annotations.exact_quote: Ground-truth inference, simply called label integration, designs proper aggregation methods to infer the unknown true label of each instance (sample) from the multiple noisy label set provided by ordinary crowd labelers (workers).
annotations.reason_zh: 论文以众包产生的多噪声标签为监督条件，研究从噪声标签集推断未知真值的标签集成，符合噪声标签学习。

annotations.exact_quote: Crowdsourcing services provide a fast, efficient, and cost-effective way to obtain large labeled data for supervised learning. Unfortunately, the quality of crowdsourced labels cannot satisfy the standards of practical applications.
annotations.reason_zh: 众包标签质量不可靠，构成不准确的监督信号，论文将其作为核心学习条件进行真值推断，符合弱监督学习。

annotations.exact_quote: Consequently, each instance absorbs a fraction of the multiple noisy label distributions from its nearest neighbors and yet simultaneously maintains a fraction of its own original multiple noisy label distribution.
annotations.reason_zh: 方法通过最近邻邻域传播并吸收标签分布、同时保留自身分布，构成基于邻域结构的几何一致性约束/图式传播。
